items.title_en: CVE-2026-111943: Compromised Intermediate Certificate Authority
items.title_zh: CVE-2026-111943：中间证书颁发机构遭受妥协
items.summary_en: A compromised intermediate certificate authority threatens TLS trust across many deployments, as certificates it issued could be misused to impersonate sites. The incident underscores how a single compromised link in the certificate chain can erode global trust and trigger urgent revocation and re-issuance of affected certificates.
items.summary_zh: CVE-2026-111943 指出中间证书颁发机构被攻破，攻击者可能滥用其签发的受信任证书伪装站点。此事件暴露证书链中单点受损就可能动摇全球信任，需要吊销、重新颁发并更新信任链。

items.title_en: mitmproxy adds --emudhra option
items.title_zh: mitmproxy 新增 --emudhra 选项
items.summary_en: mitmproxy now supports a new --emudhra flag to trust certificates issued by Emudhra, a major Indian certificate authority. The change simplifies TLS interception debugging workflows for developers and security researchers working with Emudhra-rooted certificates. Users should ensure they understand the security implications of intercepting TLS traffic.
items.summary_zh: mitmproxy 新增 --emudhra 选项，用于信任 Emudhra 颁发的证书——Emudhra 是印度的主要证书颁发机构。此变更简化了在使用 Emudhra 证书的环境中的 TLS 拦截和调试工作流程。用户应了解拦截 TLS 流量所带来的安全风险。

items.title_en: There isn't an easy exploit for this PHP vulnerability
items.title_zh: There isn't an easy exploit for this PHP vulnerability
items.summary_en: Security researchers say this PHP flaw is not easily exploitable in typical deployments. Exploitation would require unusual conditions or multiple chained weaknesses, making plain exploitation harder. Still, patching and updating dependencies remains prudent to reduce risk.
items.summary_zh: 安全研究者表示此 PHP 漏洞在常规部署中并不易被利用。利用往往需要非同寻常的条件或多重链式漏洞，单独利用难度较高。尽管如此，及时打补丁和更新依赖仍然是降低风险的明智措施。

items.title_en: Faster than earcut: triangulating 3.7M map polygons in 489 ms
items.title_zh: 比 earcut 快得多：在 489 ms 内对 370万地图多边形进行三角剖分
items.summary_en: An optimization beats earcut by large margins, triangulating 3.7 million map polygons in 489 ms. This showcases aggressive, low-level geometry processing improvements that can dramatically speed up real-time map rendering and GIS workloads. The result hints at practical gains for interactive maps, navigation, and spatial data pipelines.
items.summary_zh: 一种优化在三角剖分地图多边形上取得巨大提升，370万的多边形在489毫秒内完成。此举展示了对几何处理的底层优化如何显著提升实时地图渲染和地理信息系统工作负载的速度，预计对交互式地图、导航和空间数据管线具有实际意义。

items.title_en: Security Disclosure
items.title_zh: Railway 平台安全披露
items.summary_en: Railway has released a security disclosure detailing a vulnerability and its recommended mitigations.
items.summary_zh: Railway 发布了平台安全披露，概述了已发现的漏洞及建议的缓解措施。

items.title_zh: PHP 8.2.35 发布
items.summary_en: PHP 8.2.35 is a maintenance release that patches several security and stability issues in the 8.2 line. It’s a standard part of the PHP patch cycle, and upgrading helps close vulnerabilities and improve reliability. If you run PHP 8.2 in production, apply the update to stay supported and secure.
items.summary_zh: 这是对 8.2 分支的维护性更新，包含若干安全修复与错误修正。强烈建议在生产环境尽快升级，以降低潜在漏洞并提升稳定性。

items.title_en: WorldTUI: I trained a 360M model to pretend to be a terminal
items.title_zh: WorldTUI: 我用 360M 模型训练来假装成终端
items.summary_en: WorldTUI shows that a 360M parameter model can imitate a terminal, turning a language model into a lightweight shell agent. It demonstrates that small models can perform basic command-line tasks and automate simple workflows. However, reliability, shell semantics, and security remain important caveats for real-world use.
items.summary_zh: WorldTUI 展示了用一个 360M 参数的模型来模仿终端界面，将语言模型变成一个可编程的 shell 代理。实验表明小型模型可以完成基本命令行任务并实现简单自动化，但在可靠性、 shell 语义和安全性方面仍存在局限。此结果促使人们思考如何在不依赖大型模型的前提下提升终端工作流。

items.title_en: OpenAI CLI
items.title_zh: OpenAI 命令行界面
items.summary_en: OpenAI released an official command-line interface, letting developers interact with models, manage API keys, and automate tasks from the terminal. The CLI lowers barriers for scripting, automation, and CI workflows, complementing the Python client.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布官方命令行界面，方便开发者在终端与模型交互、管理 API Key 以及执行自动化任务。CLI 降低了上手门槛，适合在脚本、持续集成等场景使用，与 Python 客户端形成互补。

items.title_en: Today's PHP security release, and how we're strengthening security
items.title_zh: 今日 PHP 安全更新及加强安全措施
items.summary_en: A security patch release for PHP arrives today with critical fixes across core components. The team outlines stronger security practices, faster disclosure, and enhanced hardening to reduce future risk.
items.summary_zh: 今天发布了 PHP 的安全更新，修补了若干核心组件的漏洞。团队还描述了更强的防护措施、快速漏洞披露与强化发布流程，以降低未来的安全风险。对于依赖 PHP 的应用而言，及时打补丁的重要性再次凸显。

items.title_en: EA is shutting down BioWare
items.title_zh: EA 将关闭 BioWare 工作室
items.summary_en: EA is shutting down BioWare, triggering layoffs and casting uncertainty over beloved RPG franchises. The move signals bigger publisher consolidation pressures and raises questions about IP stewardship and talent retention.
items.summary_zh: EA 宣布关闭 BioWare 工作室，导致裁员并为长期受粉丝喜爱的 RPG 系列未来带来不确定性。这一举动反映了大型发行商整合压力，并引发对知识产权管理和人才保留的讨论。

items.title_en: The recently proposed o(n log n) integer multiplication algorithm [pdf]
items.title_zh: 最近提出的 o(n log n) 的整数乘法算法
items.summary_en: The paper proposes an integer multiplication algorithm with asymptotic time near n log n, challenging the long standing dominant methods. It outlines novel techniques in FFT-based arithmetic and modular transforms that push the theoretical boundary of large integer multiplication. Practical adoption remains uncertain due to big-constant factors and complexity of implementation.
items.summary_zh: 该论文提出一个在渐进时间复杂度接近 n log n 的整数乘法算法，试图挑战已有的 Schönhage-Strassen 等方法。文中描述了新颖的傅里叶变换相关技术与代数技巧，理论意义重大，可能改变大整数运算的基准。实际应用尚待验证，具体实现和常数因素将决定是否具备实用性。

items.title_en: Several Linux kernel vulnerabilities accidentally posted to public mailing list
items.title_zh: 多处 Linux 内核漏洞被误发至公开邮件列表
items.summary_en: Several Linux kernel vulnerabilities were accidentally published on a public mailing list, potentially leaking exploit details and increasing risk before patches reach users. This incident underscores the importance of secure disclosure practices and rapid remediation.
items.summary_zh: 多处 Linux 内核漏洞的细节被意外公开在公开邮件列表上，可能在补丁普及前被利用。此事件凸显负责任披露实践的重要性以及快速修复的必要性。

items.title_en: Meta ordered to pay $25B penalty in New Mexico Cambridge Analytica case
items.title_zh: Meta 因隐私问题被判罚 250 亿美元
items.summary_en: Meta faces a record $25B privacy penalty for deceptive practices around user data, signaling tougher enforcement and potential shifts in compliance spending for big platforms.
items.summary_zh: Meta 因用户隐私方面的欺骗行为被处以创纪录罚款，显示出更严格的监管执法趋势，可能推动大型平台在合规方面的投入。

items.title_en: Tell HN: I unknowingly broke the PHP RCE embargo. I am sorry.
items.title_zh: 告知 HN：我在不知情的情况下打破了 PHP RCE 禁令。我很抱歉。
items.summary_en: An honest post on Hacker News apologizes for accidentally breaking an embargo around PHP RCE details. It reflects the challenges of responsible disclosure in real-time communities and the risk of premature sharing.
items.summary_zh: 一位作者在 Hacker News 上公开道歉，称自己在不知情的情况下提前披露了有关 PHP 远程代码执行的 embargo 信息。此事凸显在实时社区中进行负责任披露的难题，以及提前分享所带来的安全风险。

items.title_en: Claude Duet
items.title_zh: Claude Duet：对话协作模型
items.summary_en: Claude Duet enables two Claude agents to collaborate, with one handling planning and the other execution, improving reliability and handling complex tasks. This duet approach aims to reduce hallucinations and offload hard reasoning, making AI copilots more practical for real work.
items.summary_zh: Claude Duet 让两个 Claude 代理协同工作，一个负责计划、一个执行，提升任务可靠性并分担复杂推理。通过二重协作的方式，这种设计旨在减少幻觉现象并提升对复杂任务的处理能力，使 AI 助手在实际场景中更具实用性。

items.title_en: Eight Bits of Trust: eMudhra's CA keys cracked in milliseconds
items.title_zh: 信任的八位字节：eMudhra 的 CA 密钥在毫秒内被破解
items.summary_en: Researchers demonstrate that eMudhra's CA keys can be cracked in milliseconds, challenging TLS trust assumptions. The result highlights how certificate authorities' key management and cryptographic agility impact the security of the entire chain, pushing for shorter certificate lifetimes and stronger hardware protections. It also underscores the need for tougher CA audits and improved trust-chain resilience.
items.summary_zh: 研究者显示 eMudhra 的 CA 钥匙可在毫秒内被破解，挑战了 TLS 信任的基本假设。此现象突显证书颁发机构在密钥管理与加密灵活性方面对整个信任链安全的影响，推动对更短证书有效期和更强硬件保护的需求，同时强调对 CA 审计和信任链韧性的改进。

items.title_en: GitLab critical patch release
items.title_zh: GitLab 发布关键补丁
items.summary_en: GitLab issued a critical patch release 19.5.1 addressing several high-severity vulnerabilities and performance issues. Users are urged to upgrade promptly, as attackers may exploit unpatched versions.
items.summary_zh: GitLab 发布了 19.5.1 版本的关键补丁，修复了若干高危漏洞并提升稳定性。强烈建议用户尽快升级，未打补丁的版本可能被利用。

items.title_en: Epic Games Inc v Apple Inc
items.title_zh: Epic Games 公司诉苹果公司
items.summary_en: A landmark legal decision in Epic Games Inc v Apple Inc in Australia addresses app-store competition and platform restrictions. The ruling could influence how developers pay for in-app purchases and the terms of the App Store in Australia.
items.summary_zh: 澳大利亚联邦法院就 Epic Games 对苹果的诉讼作出裁决，聚焦应用商店的竞争行为与平台限制，可能影响本地开发者的应用内购买规则与 App Store 条款。

items.title_en: Compromised LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI Installs a Credential Stealer and Backdoor
items.title_zh: 在 PyPI 上被篡改的 LiteLLM 1.107.0 含凭据窃取程序与后门
items.summary_en: A compromised PyPI package LiteLLM 1.107.0 ships with credential-stealing malware and a backdoor. This underscores supply-chain risk in Python ecosystems and the importance of verifying package integrity, locked versions, and thorough vetting of dependencies.
items.summary_zh: 一个被攻陷的 PyPI 包 LiteLLM 1.107.0 含有窃取凭据的恶意代码和后门。这凸显了 Python 生态的供应链风险，强调验证包完整性、审查依赖关系，以及使用固定版本的必要性。

items.title_en: Rust Style Guide
items.title_zh: 谷歌的 Rust 风格指南
items.summary_en: Google's Rust Style Guide codifies internal conventions for formatting, naming, error handling, and safety patterns, helping teams write consistent, secure Rust at scale. While tailored for Google, the guide offers useful patterns for the broader Rust community and OSS projects.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌的 Rust 风格指南将格式化、命名、错误处理与安全模式等内部约定系统化，帮助团队在大规模项目中保持一致、提高安全性。尽管面向谷歌内部，但该指南对整个 Rust 社区和开源项目也具备参考价值。

items.title_en: Airbnb bans making guests do dishes and take out the trash
items.title_zh: Airbnb 禁止让房客洗碗和倒垃圾
items.summary_en: Airbnb updated policy to ban hosts from making guests do chores such as washing dishes or taking out trash. The change aims to improve guest experience and safety, though it may affect host expectations and cost management.
items.summary_zh: Airbnb 更新政策，禁止房东要求房客做家务、洗碗或倒垃圾等。此举旨在提升体验与安全，但也可能改变房东的运营预期和清洁成本管理。

items.title_en: DuckDB 2.0.0 LTS “Cinnamon Teal”
items.title_zh: DuckDB 2.0.0 LTS Cinnamon Teal 发布
items.summary_en: DuckDB 2.0.0 LTS, nicknamed Cinnamon Teal, arrives with long-term support for analytics workloads, along with stability and performance improvements. It’s a solid choice for embedded analytics and BI workflows.
items.summary_zh: DuckDB 2.0.0 LTS（代号 Cinnamon Teal）正式发布，提供对分析工作负载的长期支持，以及稳定性与性能改进。适合嵌入式分析和 BI 工作流。

items.title_en: Jailbreaking the Switch 2
items.title_zh: Switch 2 越狱工具发布
items.summary_en: New jailbreak tooling for the Switch 2 has surfaced, enabling homebrew and custom software on Nintendo's latest console. The release underscores ongoing security tug-of-war between platform vendors and researchers, with potential risks to firmware integrity and user warranties.
items.summary_zh: Switch 2 的新越狱工具出现，使玩家能够在新版掌机上运行自制软件。此举凸显平台安全与玩家破解之间的博弈，可能对固件完整性、设备稳定性和保修造成影响。

items.title_en: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
items.title_zh: OpenAI 模型将登陆 Google Cloud
items.summary_en: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud, letting enterprises run GPT-style models within GCP. The expansion broadens enterprise AI options while intensifying competition in the cloud AI space and raising data governance considerations.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 的模型将进入 Google Cloud，企业可在 GCP 上直接使用类似 GPT 的模型。此举扩展了企业级 AI 的选择，并加剧云端 AI 领域的竞争，同时带来数据治理的新挑战。

items.title_en: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover vulnerabilities
items.title_zh: Patch the Planet：代理发现漏洞时的全球响应协调
items.summary_en: Global coordination is essential when agents uncover vulnerabilities, with a push for coordinated disclosure and cross-border collaboration. The framework outlines scalable remediation workflows and governance practices for responsible AI deployments.
items.summary_zh: Patch the Planet 探讨当自动化代理发现漏洞时，全球各方如何协同应对，强调协同披露与跨境协作，以及大规模修复的治理方法。为负责任的 AI 部署提供了可操作的框架。

items.title_en: Cloudflare is rewriting everything in Rust
items.title_zh: Cloudflare 正在用 Rust 重写一切
items.summary_en: Cloudflare is migrating core systems to Rust, citing safer memory management and performance gains. The long-term rewrite involves challenges around compatibility, tooling, and team skills, but aims to reduce security vulnerabilities.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 正在将核心系统重写为 Rust，强调内存安全与性能提升。长期重写面临兼容性、工具链与团队技能等挑战，但目标是降低安全风险并提升稳定性。

items.title_en: Oregon lawmakers approve money to buy an iconic waterfall listed on Redfin
items.title_zh: 俄勒冈州议员批准购买一处标志性瀑布的经费
items.summary_en: Oregon lawmakers allocate funds to purchase a famous waterfall that was listed for sale. The move spotlights tensions between public access, private ownership, and preservation of natural landmarks.
items.summary_zh: 俄勒冈州议员批准为这座标志性瀑布出资购置，瀑布据称在公开市场挂牌。此举凸显公共可及性、私有产权与自然地标保护之间的博弈。

items.title_en: Claude Now Works with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides
items.title_zh: Claude 现在可在 Google 文档、表格和幻灯片中使用
items.summary_en: Claude now integrates with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides, letting users generate text, summarize content, and perform data tasks directly within the apps. This tight integration boosts productivity by enabling natural-language prompts and AI-assisted edits in familiar workflows.
items.summary_zh: Claude 已与 Google 文档、表格和幻灯片深度集成，允许在应用中直接用自然语言生成文本、摘要及处理数据。此集成提升了工作效率，使 AI 辅助的编辑与分析嵌入日常工作流程。

items.title_en: The compiler was supposed to end programming too
items.title_zh: 编译器也该终结编程吗？
items.summary_en: An op-ed questions whether the future of programming might be shaped by compilers that automate or suppress routine coding, exploring the tension between automation and human creativity. It envisions a shift toward higher-level tools and AI-assisted code generation.
items.summary_zh: 一篇社论探讨编译器未来是否会通过自动化来减少人类编程工作，分析自动化与创意之间的张力。文章设想未来可能转向更高层次的工具和 AI 辅助的代码生成。

items.title_en: PingCap TiDB Leaks
items.title_zh: PingCap TiDB 漏洞曝光
items.summary_en: Security researchers report TiDB leaks that could expose sensitive data or configuration details. The note outlines the scope, risk, and recommended mitigations.
items.summary_zh: 安全研究人员披露了 PingCap TiDB 的漏洞暴露风险，可能导致敏感数据或配置信息泄露。文章概述了受影响范围、风险等级及缓解措施。

items.title_en: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
items.title_zh: 使用数千个 AI 代理在生物数据中发现新线索
items.summary_en: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 介绍通过数千个 AI 代理来挖掘生物数据中的新线索，支持并行生成假设并整合多源数据。此方法有望加速科学发现，但也对治理和数据溯源提出挑战。

items.title_en: New plastic pollution discovered: 'Plasticorals' coral rubble fused with plastic
items.title_zh: 新型塑料污染：Plasticorals 珊瑚礁碎块与塑料融合
items.summary_en: Researchers report a new form of plastic pollution where coral rubble fuses with plastic, creating 'Plasticorals'. The finding hints at a troubling feedback loop harming reef recovery and complicating cleanup, underscoring urgent plastic management.
items.summary_zh: 研究者发现一种新的塑料污染形态：珊瑚礁碎块与塑料融合，形成所谓的 Plasticorals。这一现象可能阻碍珊瑚礁恢复，并使清理工作更为复杂，凸显紧急的塑料治理需求。

items.title_en: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability
items.title_zh: Cloudflare 部署对 php2shell 漏洞的防护
items.summary_en: Cloudflare has deployed protections against the php2shell vulnerability, adding WAF rules to block exploit chains that could lead to remote code execution. The update helps shield sites without user action.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 已部署 WAF 规则来阻挡 php2shell 漏洞的利用链，降低远程代码执行风险。更新无需用户额外操作即可提升站点安全性。

items.title_en: Show HN: Omnara – Open-source alternative to Claude Managed Agents
items.title_zh: Show HN: Omnara Open source 替代 Claude 管理代理
items.summary_en: Omnara is an open source alternative to Claude's Managed Agents, offering configurable AI agents that you can run and customize yourself. The project emphasizes transparency and privacy and aims to match managed agent capabilities with self hosted deployment.
items.summary_zh: Omnara 是一个开源替代方案，定位为可本地控管的 Claude Managed Agents 的对等实现，提供可配置的 AI 代理和可插拔集成。该项目强调透明度、可定制性和隐私，面向希望自托管 AI 自动化的团队。

items.title_en: No more icons in every menu by default
items.title_zh: 默认不再在每个菜单中显示图标
items.summary_en: A design shift disables default icons in menus to reduce visual clutter and improve focus. The change sparks debate on accessibility and discoverability, while leaving customization for power users.
items.summary_zh: 设计转变在菜单中默认不再显示图标，旨在降低视觉杂乱并提升聚焦。此举引发对可访问性和可发现性的讨论，同时也让高级用户保留自定义选项。

items.title_en: Using LLM for confidence scoring is a bad idea
items.title_zh: 使用大模型进行置信度评分是个坏主意
items.summary_en: The post argues that using LLMs to generate confidence scores is a bad idea because such scores are poorly calibrated and can mislead users. It recommends separate uncertainty estimates, calibration, or human in the loop instead of relying on model self assessments.
items.summary_zh: 这篇博文质疑让大型语言模型输出自我置信度的做法，指出此类分数往往标定不准且容易产生误导。建议使用独立的不确定性指标、信息检索校验或人工在环等替代方法，而非依赖模型自我评估的置信度。

items.title_en: Postgres recovery_prefetch can cause outages
items.title_zh: Postgres recovery_prefetch 可能引发中断
items.summary_en: A PostgreSQL feature called recovery_prefetch can, in some cases, cause outages when misconfigured or buggy. The post recommends caution, disabling in production, and applying patches.
items.summary_zh: PostgreSQL 的 recovery_prefetch 功能在配置不当或实现存在缺陷时可能导致服务中断。建议在生产环境中谨慎使用、必要时禁用并及时应用修补程序。

items.title_en: Tiny possum and glider thought extinct for 6000 years found in remote West Papua
items.title_zh: 偏远的西巴布亚发现被认为灭绝约 6000 年的小负鼠与飞鼠
items.summary_en: Researchers rediscovered two marsupials in West Papua after thousands of years. The find highlights the enduring surprises in remote ecosystems and reinforces the case for protecting pristine habitats from development and habitat loss.
items.summary_zh: 科学家在西巴布亚偏远地区重新发现两种被认为已灭绝数千年的有袋动物。此发现凸显了偏远生态系统仍可能藏有新物种，也强调保护原始栖息地的重要性。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Alter (YC S25) – Access control for multi-user agents
items.title_zh: Launch HN: Alter（YC S25）——多用户代理的访问控制
items.summary_en: Alter provides access control for multi-user AI agents, enabling teams to manage permissions and boundaries across agents. The platform targets governance, security, and collaboration in complex agent workflows.
items.summary_zh: Alter 为多用户 AI 代理提供集中访问控制，使团队能够管理跨代理的权限与边界。该平台旨在提升在复杂代理工作流中的治理性、安全性与协作效率。

items.title_en: Why Windows 11 still ships with Windows 95's memory manager hidden inside it
items.title_zh: 为什么 Windows 11 仍然隐藏着 Windows 95 的内存管理器
items.summary_en: Windows 11 still includes a memory manager borrowed from Windows 95 due to compatibility and maintenance concerns. The legacy component handles memory allocation for legacy subsystems, illustrating how modern OSes juggle performance with backward compatibility.
items.summary_zh: Windows 11 仍然包含来自 Windows 95 的内存管理器，出于兼容性和维护成本考虑。该遗留组件为旧子系统提供内存管理，揭示了现代操作系统在性能与向后兼容之间的权衡。文章讨论了随着代码基的老化，设计决策的持续权衡。

items.title_en: Way to Play Super Mario 64: On Apple Vision Pro
items.title_zh: 在 Apple Vision Pro 上玩《超级马里奥64》
items.summary_en: A demonstration shows Super Mario 64 running on Apple Vision Pro, signaling how classic titles could live in AR/VR. The piece touches on input and performance trade-offs and hints at a broader future where emulation and remasters proliferate on headsets.
items.summary_zh: 演示展示了《超级马里奥64》在 Apple Vision Pro 上的运行，显示经典游戏在 AR/VR 设备中的潜在生存空间。文中讨论了输入与性能的权衡，并暗示未来头显上可能涌现更多移植与重制游戏。

items.title_en: Code is clay now
items.title_zh: 代码如今如黏土
items.summary_en: The piece argues code is malleable like clay, shaped by tools, languages, and AI-driven assistants. It reflects on how the craft of programming evolves as developers mold and remix components.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章把代码比作黏土，强调工具、语言与 AI 助手共同塑形代码的能力。它反映了开发者在设计、组合和重塑组件时，编程实践的演变。

items.title_en: Beyond the &
items.title_zh: 超越符号 & 的实践
items.summary_en: Beyond the ampersand, this piece explores more robust patterns for managing asynchronous work in Linux. It covers job control, pipelines, and modern tools that provide richer concurrency primitives and safer process management than relying on backgrounding with & alone.
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨如何在 Linux 系统中超越单纯使用符号 & 的后台任务管理，介绍更稳健的异步工作模式。内容涉及作业控制、管道设计、现代 shell 以及提供更丰富并发原语的工具，提升进程管理安全性。

items.title_en: Chain of Thought for Humans
items.title_zh: Chain of Thought for Humans
items.summary_en: Drawing parallels between AI chain-of-thought prompts and human reasoning, the piece argues that externally detailing step-by-step thought processes can improve human problem solving. It offers practical practices for structuring thinking and recording reasoning, similar to how prompts guide AI thinking.
items.summary_zh: 本文将 AI 的连锁推理与人类推理联系起来，主张通过外显分步推理来提升人类解决问题的能力，并给出将推理过程结构化并记录的实用做法。

items.title_en: What Is the Karakoram Anomaly?
items.title_zh: 卡拉科姆异常是什么？
items.summary_en: Researchers describe the Karakoram Anomaly, where glaciers in the Karakoram range are not retreating as quickly as global trends, with some stability or growth. Ongoing work points to snowfall, glacier dynamics, and topography, bearing implications for water security in the region.
items.summary_zh: 卡拉科姆异常指的是卡拉科姆山脉的冰川退缩速度低于全球平均，部分区域甚至稳定或增长。研究持续探索降雪、冰川动力和地形等因素，对南亚地区的水资源安全具有重要影响。

items.title_en: ThinkPad I9990303 Error Catch-22
items.title_zh: ThinkPad I9990303 错误的进退两难
items.summary_en: A ThinkPad error labeled I9990303 presents a Catch-22 for diagnosis, with conflicting symptoms and limited repair options.
items.summary_zh: ThinkPad 的 I9990303 错误被描述为诊断上的进退两难，症状相互矛盾，维修选项受限。文章分析了错误持续的原因，以及厂商在调试与硬件故障隔离方面的挑战。

items.title_en: The Robot I Didn't Expect to Build
items.title_zh: 我没想到要打造的机器人
items.summary_en: Agility Robotics reveals why Digit 5's redesign emphasizes reliability, safety, and cost, focusing on real-world deployment rather than flashy capabilities. The project illustrates how practical constraints shape robotics tooling and applications.
items.summary_zh: Agility Robotics 讲述 Digit 5 的重新设计如何聚焦可靠性、安全性与成本，优先考虑现实部署而非花哨功能。这个改造案例展示了实际约束如何推动机器人技术走向真实应用。

items.title_en: Startup taps underwater volcano as energy source in "proof point" test
items.title_zh: 初创公司以海底火山作为能源进行实证测试
items.summary_en: One startup is harvesting energy from an underwater volcanic vent to run a proof-of-concept test. If successful, it could signal a path for offshore geothermal energy and extreme-environment power systems, though challenges include corrosion, reliability, and power transmission.
items.summary_zh: 一家初创公司正在海底火山喷口提取地热能以进行实证测试。若成功，可能为海上地热和极端环境能源系统铺路，但腐蚀、可靠性和能量传输等挑战仍需克服。

items.title_en: I can't use generic lambdas at compile-time, now what?
items.title_zh: 我不能在编译时使用泛型 Lambda，该怎么办？
items.summary_en: A discussion of the limitations of generic lambdas in compile-time contexts, outlining the constraints and potential workarounds such as using function objects or template tricks. The post also hints at evolving compiler support and patterns.
items.summary_zh: 本文阐述泛型 lambda 在编译时上下文中的限制，介绍相关约束及替代方案，如使用函数对象或模板技巧，并提及编译器支持的发展趋势。

items.title_en: Eigenmoon: linear algebra puzzles by moonlight
items.title_zh: Eigenmoon：月光下的线性代数谜题
items.summary_en: Eigenmoon presents linear algebra puzzles with a moonlit theme, offering interactive challenges around eigenvectors, linear transformations, and vector spaces. It's a playful learning tool that gamifies core math concepts for enthusiasts and students.
items.summary_zh: Eigenmoon 在月光主题下提供线性代数谜题，围绕特征向量、线性变换和向量空间等概念设有互动题目。它把核心数学知识以游戏化方式呈现，适合爱好者和学生练习。
